ABOUT US

Four decades of engineering. Built for what matters.

Since 1986, we have built our capabilities around dependable electrical and power solutions for demanding applications. From our Delhi manufacturing facility, engineering, manufacturing, testing and service come together to deliver products designed for real-world performance.

Our experience spans industry, defence and government institutions, where reliability, technical understanding and consistent support matter. With more than 25 years of defence-sector experience, we understand the importance of demanding requirements while maintaining the practical, responsive approach of an experienced engineering company.

Why true engineers specify Sinetrac

Build specification selected to suit the customer’s application and order requirements.

  • Build specification selected to suit the customer’s application and order requirements.
  • Electronic circuitry built on standard German & Indian components (Philips ICs, Semikron IGBTs) — no unproven low-cost imports
  • Every unit tested on double the voltage & frequency (DVDF) rigs and full-load test benches before dispatch
  • Approved by E-in-C’s Branch and Central, Western, Northern, Southern & SW Commands
Inside the plant

Built and proven at Delhi.

Vacuum Impregnation Plant

Windings are vacuum-impregnated for moisture resistance and long service life.

Double Voltage & Frequency (DVDF) Test

Every transformer is proof-tested at the rated voltage and frequency.

Servo Stabilizer Test Panel

Input/output current and voltage are logged on a dedicated panel before dispatch.

Full Load Test Bench

Finished units run at full rated load to confirm regulation and thermal performance.

How it’s actually built

Two production lines, one quality gate.

Every transformer and every electronic assembly follows its own documented process before the two come together as a finished unit.

Transformer & Final Product

I.Q.C.→ Winding→ Termination→ Core Stacking→ High Voltage Test→ Clamping→ Testing→ Insulation→ Physical Check→ Induced Voltage Test→ Packing

Electronic Assembly

I.Q.C.→ Electronic Components Mounting→ Soldering→ Fitting→ Wiring→ Testing→ Load Test→ Packing
